name: techdella/workflow-canvas
title: Workflow canvas
description: Automation workflow mock: nodes joined by SVG lines that light up in sequence (static under reduced motion). An ordered list for screen readers; always labelled as an example. Bare by default so it can sit in a hero's right-hand slot.
